caption: The drawing features a framed rectangular sign, predominantly in shades of gray, supported by four vertical posts with ornamental tops and bases. At the top, there is a decorative element consisting of two symmetrical scroll-like shapes with a finial in the center. Within the frame, a large, circular medallion appears, bordered by small gold stars on a dark blue background, inside which the word "LIBERTY" is inscribed in gold letters. Inside the medallion is a right-facing profile of a woman wearing a classical helmet, rendered in gray tones. Below the medallion, the initials "J.P." are displayed in yellow on a black rectangular field. The bottom of the frame features the number "1801" written in blue-gray, centered within a shaped, scalloped panel. The background of the drawing is a light beige color with some brown discoloration at the edges.
title: Tavern Sign
